name: Income Insurance Limited

scam_info.sample: Registered website domains: income.com.sg snackbyincome.sg Marketing email addresses: marketing@send.income.com.sg ... Income only uses these domains: income.com.sg, einco.me and ntucinco.me .
scam_info.notes: Security Advisory: top alert on phone scams using the MAS Register of Representatives to impersonate Income reps ('will never call on behalf of MAS'); scam explainers; FAQ listing authorised website domains, marketing email senders (marketing@send.income.com.sg, info@go.income.com.sg), link domains einco.me / ntucinco.me (short links), customer service 6788 1777 and outbound calling numbers 6645 5141 / 6571 6565. Date = sitemap lastmod. No fake indicators. Emails were Cloudflare-obfuscated in HTML (decoded).

notes: All four official_domains are (a) explicitly listed on /security-advisory. einco.me / ntucinco.me appear to be link domains ('Ensure legitimacy of shared links. Income only uses these domains'). Press release on motor insurance fraud also in sitemap (/about-us/corporate-information/press-releases/motor-insurance-fraud-cases; not opened).
